title: A Linear issue comment claims a milestone shipped that's still open
author: off-by-one
description: The Linear source's second claims-X leg, alongside linear-comment-claims-unfixed-issue (task 600) -- a third leg, linear-comment-claims-unmerged-pr, remains open for a future hour. Extracts every 'milestone #N' claim phrase (milestone_claims.py's shared grammar, imported verbatim, the twelfth recipe to bind to it) from a Linear issue comment's own text and cross-checks it against the live milestone tracker's own state -- the identical milestone-claim check slack-message-claims-open-milestone already runs against a Slack channel message, applied here to the Linear issue-comment surface linear-comment-claims-unfixed-issue already opened. A milestone that exists but is still open is the seam: a comment already sitting on a Linear issue disagrees with GitHub's own record, and nothing on either platform ever compares them. This closes a cell in the claims-X grid (ten sources -- mention, tweet, issue-comment, review-comment, milestone, readme, release, commit, slack-message, linear-comment -- times three targets -- open-milestone, unfixed-issue, unmerged-pr): after this recipe, slack-message-claims-unmerged-pr and linear-comment-claims-unmerged-pr remain the two genuinely open cells, while commit-claims-unfixed-issue and commit-claims-unmerged-pr stay the two structurally-unfillable cells task 599's own history already named (commit-closes-keyword-issue-still-open/commit-closes-keyword-pr-still-open already cover that identical semantic space under a different recipe name). Fixture-only, MOCK ONLY, never a live network call -- the-hand gateway holds a real, connected upstream Linear app but exposes zero Linear-capable tools on its live toolset today, same WIP note linear-comment-claims-unfixed-issue already carries. Neither scope is new (both already registered from task 600/founding) and linear+github is not a new toolkit pair (linear-comment-claims-unfixed-issue already proposed it).
confidence_notes: Age-gated by hours since the comment's own created_at, holding slack-message-claims-open-milestone's own 0.85/0.5 bar exactly -- not an independently re-reasoned number just because the claim is posted on a Linear issue rather than a Slack channel. A Linear issue comment is posted once and stands, exactly as durable and readable-later as a Slack channel message, a tweet, or a mention once posted -- mention-claims-open-milestone's/tweet-claims-open-milestone's/slack-message-claims-open-milestone's identical bar applies, not review-comment-claims-open-milestone's lower 0.55/0.85 bar for an editable surface. A claim checked within 24 hours of posting might still be a race (the milestone actually closing out moments after the comment went out) rather than a settled public overclaim (0.5, below the 0.70 confidence bar, shown as a weighed-and-dropped coincidence, not hidden). At or past 24 hours with the named milestone still open, it is unambiguous (flat 0.85). The check itself is objective, same reasoning as every claims-open-milestone sibling: the claimed milestone's own live state field, verified against ListMilestones, not a guess about which tracker the commenter meant. A named milestone that does not exist at all is excluded at confidence 0.0, named not hidden -- a broken reference is a future Linear-side dangling-reference recipe's own seam, not this one's. A named milestone that IS closed is excluded too -- the claim was simply true. A comment with no 'milestone #N' claim phrase at all produces no candidate. No text in this recipe's own headline/detail strings ever names or grades the Linear commenter -- CONTRIBUTING.md's 'No grading, ever' law, same as every recipe in this engine.
